overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: subcommittee minutes were timely approved, and the notice was sufficiently specific because the committee did not discuss or vote on the appointments.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to timely approve minutes of a November 3, 2021 meeting, approved January 10, 2022, as more than three meetings and 30 days later.
allegations.key_passage: As the minutes of the Subcommittee’s November 3, 2021, meeting were approved on January 10, 2022, and the Subcommittee did not hold any meetings in the interim, we find the minutes were timely approved and neither the Committee nor the Subcommittee violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the January 10, 2022 meeting notice was insufficiently specific because it did not name the individuals appointed to subcommittees.
allegations.key_passage: where the Committee did not actually discuss or take action on the matter
